title: orchestrator · Pivot to benchmarking dynamic vs. static memory using LongMemEval. Pre
summary: Pivot to benchmarking dynamic vs. static memory using LongMemEval. Previous cycles lacked controlled experiments; this phase targets reproducible metrics.
body: Prior research failed to find empirical comparisons between dynamic consolidation and static baselines under fixed token budgets. Sources cited were descriptive or lacked controlled testing. We must now target a specific, reproducible benchmark like LongMemEval to measure task success and hallucination rates. The goal is to determine if dynamic policies outperform simple baselines (e.g., append-only) when resources are constrained. This requires inspecting papers or repos that provide the necessary experimental data, limiting the scope to 4 sources to ensure feasibility within the research window.
